en.title: Manage research paper pages
en.description: Prepare and manage paper pages and model/dataset links on Hugging Face.
tasks: Prepare and manage paper pages and model/dataset links on Hugging Face.
prerequisites: Python/uv, Hub account, and write-scoped HF_TOKEN for publishing actions.
en.example: Use huggingface-paper-publisher. Prepare metadata linking my arXiv paper to this model repository; show the proposed changes first.
en.expectedResult: Validated paper metadata and a reviewable linking or publication plan.
limitations: Publishing and claiming authorship change public records and require appropriate permissions.

zh.title: 管理研究论文页面
zh.description: 准备并管理 Hugging Face 论文页面及模型、数据集关联。
tasks: 准备并管理 Hugging Face 论文页面及模型、数据集关联。
prerequisites: Python/uv、Hub 账号；发布操作需要有写入权限的 HF_TOKEN。
zh.example: 请使用 huggingface-paper-publisher：准备把我的 arXiv 论文关联到此模型仓库的元数据，先展示拟修改内容。
zh.expectedResult: 核对后的论文元数据及可审阅的关联或发布计划。
limitations: 发布与认领作者身份会改变公开记录，需具备相应权限。
